exampleInput: Develop a treatment from this logline: a burned-out Stockholm paramedic discovers her new AI dispatch system is quietly deprioritising emergency calls from a poor suburb — and the only person who believes her is the teenage hacker whose mother the system left to die. Feature film, Nordic-noir-leaning thriller with a social-drama spine, around 110 minutes, contained budget (two districts, ambulance interiors, one data-centre location). I have the protagonist's arc roughly mapped — she starts complicit and exhausted, ends whistleblowing at real personal cost — but I need a beat-sheet treatment, an antagonist who is more than an 'evil tech company', and a midpoint that genuinely escalates.

exampleValues.tone_reference: Nordic noir meets whistleblower drama — 'The Bridge' tension with 'Dark Waters' moral weight
exampleValues.constraints: Contained budget: two Stockholm districts, ambulance interiors, one data-centre location. Target ~110 minutes. Swedish-language with English-market potential.
exampleValues.existing_material: Logline: a burned-out Stockholm paramedic discovers her new AI dispatch system is quietly deprioritising emergency calls from a poor suburb — the only person who believes her is the teenage hacker whose mother the system left to die. Protagonist arc: complicit and exhausted → whistleblower at real personal cost. Antagonist should be institutional and human (a plausible, budget-pressured official), not a cartoon tech villain.
